title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-27

ai_review.summary: Great 1973 Friday‑night party captured with decent audio that improves to near‑spectacular quality by Bird Song.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the performance, noting a high‑energy Friday night party that turned into an impromptu two‑hour soundcheck set. The tape’s fidelity is modest—early sections are a bit rough—but it brightens up and approaches spectacular clarity by the time "Bird Song" rolls around.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave high star ratings (4‑5) and highlighted a strong show with only minor recording shortcomings, leading to an overall rating above four stars despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape is decent for a 1973 audience‑style capture; early parts sound rough but improve noticeably by "Bird Song", approaching spectacular quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A spontaneous two‑hour soundcheck concert that maintained high momentum throughout the party atmosphere.
